shots.text: Gorrath the Quarried once held the Kharum Pass for a month. He carved out his own heart to hold the Rift for his new master.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Gorrath breaking apart on the ridge into boulders that keep rolling, then stop. The carved stone heart in his chest cracks.

shots.text: Out of the ridge-dust rode the Marshal of the Steppe, who had been hunted across the plateau for eleven days, and had not once ridden in the direction of retreat.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Kaela Stormrider bursting out of the dust on her grey stallion Thunderclap, lightning lance crackling, white war-paint across her face.

shots.text: Retreat? The Galeborn have no word for it. You will have to teach me one.
shots.speaker: kaela
shots.art_note: Kaela reining in beside the player's towers, looking back at Highwind. Joins as a hero.
